name: After § 3
title: REPORT on the 2025 Commission report on Ukraine
part_text: 3a. Calls on the Council, the High Representative of the Union for Foreign Affairs and Security Policy and the Commission to appoint, without further delay, one or more EU Special Envoys for Peace in Ukraine, with a clear mandate to engage all parties to the conflict, as well as key international actors; stresses that such an appointment must be accompanied by a structured negotiating brief, adequate resources, and regular reporting to Parliament; recalls that effective mediation requires direct engagement with all parties to a conflict, including those whose conduct is condemned;
